bottom_line: The pool opens for the winter season on November 1.

headline.dek: Council votes 7-2 to keep the Riverside Pool open through the winter.
headline.title: Council votes 7-2 to keep the pool open

scenes.question: What did the council decide?
scenes.why: Four essentials at a glance: the vote, the cost, the petition and the season.

events.what: Council proposes closing the pool for the winter
Residents hand in a petition with 1,240 signatures
Council votes 7-2 to keep the pool open
Pool opens for the winter season

scenes.question: How did we get here?
scenes.why: A dated sequence from proposal to vote, with the opening still to come.

data.speaker: Councillor Tom Adeyemi
data.text: The pool is where the town learns to swim. Closing it for four months every year was the wrong saving.

scenes.question: Why keep it open?
scenes.why: The councillor's own words carry the decision: the pool is where the town learns to swim.
